paragraphs.text: A chimera is a creature type for a mythological, fire-breathing monster, commonly represented with a lion 's head, a goat 's body, and a serpent 's tail. The term can also be used for any similarly grotesque monster having disparate parts.

Chimeras are primarily blue and secondary in green , white , and red . Chimeras have also appeared as colorless artifact creatures. Volatile Chimera ( Conspiracy: Take the Crown ) and Daybreak Chimera are currently the only mono-red and mono-white chimeras, respectively.

The Chimera creature type was introduced with of a cycle of four uncommon 2/2 artifact creatures in Visions costing : Brass-Talon Chimera , Iron-Heart Chimera , Lead-Belly Chimera , Tin-Wing Chimera . Originally subtype-less, the subtype Chimera was specially created for these cards in the Magic Online release of Visions .
Chimera would return as a type Theros block , and was no longer restricted to artifact creatures. Commander 2020 introduced Majestic Myriarch , the first mono- green chimera.
Chimeras exist in Amonkhet , though their nature is not elaborated upon.
Professor Hofri Ghostforge has employed a chimera spirit statue as a docent during some of his exams . It is currently unknown if living chimeras are also present on Arcavios .
A set of chimeric artifact creatures existed in Jamuraa during the Mirage War . However, not much is known about them.
Chimera statues resembling lion dogs appear to guard the paths around Pearl Lake .

On Theros chimeras are magical fusions of creatures' life essences, often multiheaded, winged and dangerous. Chimeras are suspected to be the result of the god Keranos ' folly, burning mages' minds with lightning and inspiring them to create these things. Others suspect that chimeras might be linked to a now-defunct city, whose inhabitants used magic carelessly. Rise to the Challenge shows that Chimeras can be killed.

According to an Akroan tale, the god Keranos sought to test Renata by creating a beast so deadly that even she would balk at trying to hunt it. When Renata slayed this lion-ram-dragon creation effortlessly (the first chimera of Theros), Keranos created another combination of deadlier beasts to challenge her. She slayed that beast too, and all the other countless Keranos' creations.
Chimeras also exist on Amonkhet and Fiora .

The Chimeras in Visions ' were designed to evoke a feeling of mechanoid creatures that could combine to make a singular, large monster. Consequently, each chimera in the cycle had a combat ability and a sacrifice ability to give any chimera a +2/+2 counter and that chimera's combat ability.
The Chimeras' ability to grant their combat ability to other chimeras resembles the use of keyword counters in later sets. If R&D remade them today, they would definitely use keyword counters.
